args.brief: Chapter 3, "The Duplicate". Aster reads the handling note and obtains the duplicate page of the canopy register from Kei; the delivery dispute is resolved. In this chapter Jo discovers a blue square on the duplicate page and explains it aloud to Aster — Jo speaks the explanation, Aster listens. Keep the seed capsule sealed and intact throughout; no one is physically injured; keep handling and record-keeping actions precise (gloves, tweezers, page order, a stable table). Third person past tense, centred on Aster, quiet tone, about 750 words. Do not alter chapter 1.

actions.reply: Chapter 3 is committed with no retained risks—Jo finds the blue square on the duplicate page and explains it aloud to Aster, whose quiet reading of the handling note resolves the delivery dispute. The seed capsule stays sealed and intact, no one is injured, and the demonstration proceeds. That brings the book to the three-chapter target.
